Please append a short entry to `teams/mvox-dev/memory/architecture-decisions.md` codifying the rule. Suggested shape:

---

### Dispatch-message Co-authored-by trailers short-circuit prepare-commit-msg hook (2026-05-24, session 22)

**Decision**: Team-lead dispatch messages MUST NOT include `Co-authored-by:` lines in commit-message templates. Use `Contributors:` (or body prose, or `Reviewed-by:`) for team attribution.

**Why**: `.githooks/prepare-commit-msg` uses `git interpret-trailers --if-exists doNothing`. When the dispatch-message template already contains any `Co-authored-by:` trailer (even a malformed group form like `Co-authored-by: Comenius, Tallis, Byrd, Bentham (review)`), the hook short-circuits on key match and the PO co-author trailer (`mihkel.putrinsh@gmail.com`) is silently dropped.

**Exemplar**: session-22 squash `9637eee` (CHORE-62 + CHORE-63). Closes #62 + #63 landed cleanly but the squash lacks the PO trailer.

**Rule**: 
- Dispatch templates: attribution goes in body prose or under `Contributors:` / `Reviewed-by:` / `Helped-by:` (any sentinel that isn't `Co-authored-by:`).
- Genuine multi-author co-authorship (where the second author is a real git identity with email): list each as its own `Co-authored-by: Name <email>` line. The hook deduplicates on full value, so distinct properly-formatted co-author trailers all survive.
- Implementers writing their own commits: same rule — never write malformed group-form `Co-authored-by:` lines.

(*MVOX:Josquin*)

---

Adjust the wording / tag (`[DECISION]` or similar) as you see fit. Commit + push the arch-decisions update directly to main (small doc-only commit, no branch needed).

Then mark Tasks #1 + #7 done is on me — go idle when arch-decisions is committed. Bentham can review/prune later as steward.
